_source.title: 获取指定分屏 ID 下的所有标签页
_source.remarks.text.0: 如果指定分屏下不存在直接标签页（即它属下还存在 {@link IDMT_EditorSplitScreenItem.children | children}），则返回空数组

title: Get all tabs under the specified split screen ID
remarks.text.0: If there are no direct tabs under the specified split screen (that is, it still has {@link IDMT_EditorSplitScreenItem.children | children} under it), an empty array will be returned
